correctness.rationale: The Kirchhoff index is N[tr((L+J)^{-1})−1] on connected supports. The strictly convex trace-inverse functional plus the injective simple-edge Laplacian parametrization makes the global budget optimum unique, so page permutations and hub-exchange reflection force common outer weight a, middle weight b, shared-hub edge q. Orthogonal page-difference subspaces plus even and odd hub modes yield the stated four-term spectral formula. A feasible derivative at b=0 is strictly negative, excluding all middle-edge omissions. With r=b/a and t=q/a the boundary q=0 has one positive optimum ratio r_m solving g_m+(2+r)g_mʹ=0; its KKT bridge derivative has sign g_m(r_m)(d−d_m*), establishing zero edge iff d>=d_m*, with equality, and unique strictly positive q below. The m=2 root r=1 yields d*=99/35 and the leading polynomial root r∞=(sqrt(3)−1)/2 yields m d_m*→3+3sqrt(3)/2. Independent exact symbolic derivative checking and full rational Laplacian inversion for m=2,3,5 agreed with the source spectral formula. The infinitude and all prices follow from strict convex/KKT, not a numerical grid.
